errata.orig: ct-Data CONTENT-TYPE ::= {OCTET STRING IDENTIFIED BY id-data}

errata.notes: The wrong oid arc was used for the module identification.  A similar changes is also being reported for RFC 5912
One incorrect node in the arc was noted from the last errata.

errata.orig:
ContentInfo
   FROM CryptographicMessageSyntax2004
       { iso(1) member-body(2) us(840) rsadsi(113549)
       pkcs(1) pkcs-9(9) smime(16) modules(0) id-mod-cms-2004-02(41) } ;
errata.correct:
ContentInfo
   FROM CryptographicMessageSyntax-2009
       {iso(1) member-body(2) us(840) rsadsi(113549) pkcs(1) pkcs-9(9)
        smime(16) modules(0) id-mod-cms-2004-02(41)};
errata.notes: ContentInfo to be imported from the module that is defined elsewhere in RFC 5911.
cea-aes192-GCM and cea-aes256-GCM were both using id-aes128-GCM as their IDENTIFIER instead of the correct 192/256 identifier.
